speech.long: Hello from Eliza. This is a local speech benchmark. The same words and voice are used for every request so that we can compare generation time and server concurrency. A quiet room and a steady clock help us measure the work. We keep the text fixed and collect every sample. Several clients can ask for speech at the same time. Some will wait for a worker while others receive audio. We measure that waiting time together with synthesis and encoding. These results describe this computer and this workload.
